title: Next-generation AI for advanced threat detection and security enhancement in DNS over HTTPS
venue: Journal of Network and Computer Applications

value.name: doh_real_world_2022
value.quote: Empirical evaluation on the doh_real_world_2022 dataset demonstrates 99.1% detection accuracy with C

datasets_evaluated.evidence: Empirical evaluation on the doh_real_world_2022 dataset demonstrates 99.1% detection accuracy with CapsNets, 98.8% with GraphTransformers, and an 80% improvement in adversarial resilience.

label_source.evidence: DoH traffic was collected from actual sources and subsequently enriched with synthetically generated attack patterns in order to increase diversity and enrich the dataset.

label_feature_overlap.evidence: The model received regular injections of adverse samples during training which forced it to establish critical differences between normal and abnormal queries to achieve improved defense against sophisticated evasion methods.

features_used.evidence: DNS Query Patterns—Characterizing query entropy, frequency, and domain length distributions. TLS listening metadata—Monitoring ciphersuite usage, session resumption behavior, and certificates. DoH-Specific HTTP Header Analysis—Identification of content type mismatch anomalies, HTTP request patterns, and response latencies anomalies.

feature_groups.evidence: DNS Query Patterns—Characterizing query entropy, frequency, and domain length distributions. TLS listening metadata—Monitoring ciphersuite usage, session resumption behavior, and certificates. Temporal Traffic Pattern—Application of time-series analysis for the identification of query timing and inter-arrival times anomalies.

cert_fields_read.evidence: TLS listening metadata—Monitoring ciphersuite usage, session resumption behavior, and certificates.

fingerprints_used.evidence: Existing prior works have either focused on statistical anomaly detection or basic supervised learning models with light features.

model_family.evidence: Specifically, Capsule Networks (CapsNets) are used to learn hierarchical traffic flow patterns, Graph Transformers to uncover temporal anomalies

split_protocols.evidence: We applied the same dataset splits, the identical hyperparameter configuration (e.g., learning rate, optimizer, batch size), and the identical hardware resources for training and inference.

shortcut_check.evidence: To validate the architectural sensitivity of our Capsule Network module, we conducted a controlled ablation study in which we varied capsule sizes, routing iterations, and hierarchical depths.
